# Tritium breeding

<!-- Generated by tools/generate.py from atlas/energy/tritium-breeding.toml. Do not edit by hand. -->

## Scope

In: breeding blankets, tritium extraction and the plant's fuel cycle. Out: the plasma or target physics itself (energy/fusion-power) and lithium-isotope enrichment supply, which is not yet in the atlas.
